title: meept WS event surface (issue #48 Tier 3)
description: Contract for the flattened frames emitted by the daemon's WS relay (internal/comm/http/server.go transformBusEventToWS). Only the two stable typed shapes are specified: chat_message (normalized by the relay) and agent_progress frames carrying the frozen agent.TurnTerminalEvent payload. The Dart models in ui/flutter_ui/lib/models/ws_events.dart mirror this file; internal/comm/http/ws_schema_drift_test.go validates marshaled Go payloads against it and fails on drift.

rfc3339String.description: RFC3339 timestamp injected by the relay when the payload has none.

chat_message.description: chat_message classification. Published by ChatHandler.publishChatMessage (internal/agent/handler.go) and the chat.message.received broadcast; normalized by the relay: session_id falls back to conversation_id, content mirrors reply, role defaults to assistant, id defaults to the bus message ID.

turn_terminal.description: agent_progress classification carrying the frozen agent.TurnTerminalEvent payload (internal/agent/handler.go, turn.terminal topic; CLOSED field set). Optional here == Go omitempty. Identified on the client by payload shape: turn_id AND handler_case present and non-empty.

status.description: CLOSED set: completed | failed | timeout | parked.

oneOf.description: Heterogeneous relay shapes (metrics_update, job_update, plan_update, generic event) deliberately left schema-free: only the type key is contractual.
